# task\-merged\-work\-still\-open — Warn when an open task's commit is already merged into the coordination branch
status: todo  priority: 3  scope: scope-git
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

After a PR merges, its task often stays in\_progress \(or review\) with an active claim because nobody ran \`task finish\`\. Git already knows: the implementation commit is reachable from the coordination branch\. Add a read\-only check, surfaced by \`validate\` and \`sync\`, that finds tasks in a non\-terminal status whose work has landed, and emits an actionable warning such as \`task X is in\_progress but commit \<sha\> is merged into main; run task finish X \-\-commit \<sha\>\`\. Evidence sources, in order: \(1\) commits already recorded on the task \(TaskRecord\.commits\), \(2\) commits on the coordination branch carrying a \`Waystation\-Task: \<id\>\` trailer, parsed with the existing W03 parser in src/core/trailers\.ts\. Reachability is \`git merge\-base \-\-is\-ancestor \<sha\> \<branch\>\` via runSafeGit\. Bound the trailer scan \(e\.g\. commits since the task's claimed\_at or a fixed recent window\) so validate stays fast\. This check only warns; it never changes task status\. Closing stays an explicit command, per the contract freeze \(docs/git\-hermes\-contract\-freeze\.md section 2\.5\)\.

## Acceptance
- validate and sync emit a new warning code \(declared in the result\.ts CODES catalog with message, hint and retryable\) for each non\-terminal task with a recorded or trailer\-linked commit reachable from the coordination branch\.
- The hint names the exact \`task finish \<id\> \-\-agent \<claim agent\> \-\-commit \<sha\>\` command to run\.
- No warning for done/wont\_do tasks, for commits not yet reachable, or outside a Git repository; the check never mutates the ledger\.
- The coordination branch defaults to main and can be configured in config\.json \(shared with task\-guard\-branch\-ledger\-commits\)\.
- Tests use a real git fixture covering a recorded commit, a trailer\-only commit, an unmerged commit, a terminal task, and a non\-Git ledger\.
- bun test, typecheck, biome check and waystation validate are clean\.
